improvements.suggestion: Caraway and cumin are essential companions in Harissa, where the warm, earthy notes of cumin meld beautifully with the distinct, slightly sweet anise flavor of caraway, creating a complex and inviting spice blend that enhances the depth of various dishes.
improvements.rationale: Their harmonious balance of warmth and brightness not only heightens flavors but also reflects a rich culinary tradition that celebrates the interplay of spices.
